subject: Checkout latency spike / p95-p99 regression — suspected client retry/timeouts
messages:
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@brightcart.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightCart SRE <sre@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Checkout latency spike affecting peak traffic

Hi Hannah,

We started seeing a noticeable spike in API latency around 08:50 PT this morning. Checkout throughput dropped and our users saw multiple failed checkout attempts. p95 went from ~120ms to ~1.1s and p99 spiked to ~3.5s for a ~25 minute window. Attached are three sample request IDs and our client-side timing logs:

- request id: bc-req-20260630-88a1
- request id: bc-req-20260630-88a2
- request id: bc-req-20260630-88a3

We rely on Redwood hosted API for tokenization and realtime personalization. Our SRE is seeing a lot of spikes correlated with a burst of retries from several backend hosts. Can you confirm whether this was on Redwood's side or if there's something our SDK is doing incorrectly? This is impacting revenue — we need an immediate post-mortem and a mitigation plan.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Liu
Head of Platform
BrightCart

(attachments: client_timings_20260630.csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout latency spike affecting peak traffic

Thanks for the heads up Ethan — sorry you're seeing this. Monica, Hiro, Marissa: looping you in for immediate triage.

Summary from customer: p95 -> ~1.1s, p99 -> ~3.5s, ~25 minute window starting ~08:50 PT. Customer sees correlated client retries.

Immediate asks:
- Hiro: please validate whether hosted API had any rolling restarts, node evictions, or a model fallback around that window and share p95/p99 by AZ.
- Monica/CS: let me know if we should advise BrightCart to temporarily relax client retry behavior or increase client-side timeouts while we investigate.
- Marissa: flag deal BRG-3245 for potential SLA credit if we confirm a Redwood-side regression.

I'll keep Ethan updated.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

(Quick note: attaching our internal incident dashboard shortly.)

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout latency spike affecting peak traffic

Quick initial findings from infra: attaching a screenshot of the p95/p99 time-series and a small sample of request logs (p99 spikes highlighted). Attachments: p99_dashboard.png, logs_sample.txt

What I see:
- Our hosted API metrics show a modest p95 elevation from 08:48–09:10 PT, but the magnitude on our side (p99 ~900ms) does not fully match the customer's reported 3.5s p99.
- There were no cluster-wide restarts or model evictions in that window.
- However, we see repeated identical request signatures from a small set of client IPs and user agents — bursts of retries at ~100ms intervals for requests that were likely timing out on the client. That pattern can inflate perceived p99 at the customer if their client aggregates end-to-end time including retries.
- Token service latency (our internal sub-call) did show a tail event on one node for ~2m due to transient GC around 08:49, which likely bumped server-side p99 to ~1.2s for those specific RPCs.

Hypothesis: combination of a short-lived server-side tail event + aggressive client SDK retry semantics and low client-side timeouts is producing an outsized p99 observed by BrightCart. In short, some of the customer's p99 is client-side retry re-attribution.

Next steps I recommend right now:
1) Ask the customer to temporarily disable client retry jitter or increase their SDK timeout to 3s for checkout paths (safe for a short mitigation).
2) We correlate request IDs across both logs (customer-supplied request ids in their CSV) to quantify how many p99s are pure server-side vs. client-side aggregated.
3) Post-mortem to root cause the GC spike and patch metrics to better surface these subcomponent tails.

I'll start on step (2) now — attaching logs_sample.txt and a snapshot of our dashboard.

—Hiro
Hiro Tanaka
Senior Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

(attachments: p99_dashboard.png, logs_sample.txt)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@brightcart.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Checkout latency spike affecting peak traffic

Ethan — sorry again for the outage this morning. We want to get you stable ASAP. Immediate actions we've taken:
- Increased request concurrency headroom on your tenant by 25% for the next 2 hours.
- Applied a temporary soft-limit on retry amplification from our edge for identical request signatures (low-risk, reversible).
- Provided a short mitigation recommendation: bump the SDK timeout for checkout calls to 3000ms and disable sub-second retry intervals.

We also attached a short mutual action plan (BrightCart-MAP-v1.pdf) outlining the triage steps, timelines for correlation (we'll complete cross-log aggregation by 11:30 PT), and a runway for next steps (post-mortem + SLA/credit determination).

Please confirm once you have changed the SDK timeout so we can monitor the impact.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

(attachments: BrightCart-MAP-v1.pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec brief: BrightCart checkout latency escalation (BRG-3245)

Markus — FYI and asking for guidance on credits/SLA exception. Quick summary:
- Incident window: 08:48–09:13 PT on 2026-06-30.
- Customer-observed p99: ~3.5s. Our hosted API p99 peaked ~1.2s on a constrained token service node.
- Root cause (preliminary): transient GC tail on a token-service node + aggressive client retry behavior on BrightCart that amplified end-to-end p99.
- Mitigations applied: tenant headroom increase, edge soft-limit on retry amplification, customer advised to increase SDK timeout to 3s. Cross-log correlation in progress; final RCA and credit recommendation pending.

Customer impact: checkout failures/slowness for ~25 minutes; revenue impact being estimated by BrightCart.

Request: Can we pre-approve a goodwill credit of up to one week of standard usage for BRG-3245 pending final RCA? If not pre-approved, please let me know the decision path and the owner to sign off quickly.

I'll send the final RCA and proposed SLA credit once we complete the correlation (ETA 11:30 PT = 18:30 UTC).

—Hannah
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
